blocks.text: Aldehydes aur ketones hydrogen cyanide se react kar ke cyanohydrins (hydroxynitriles) banate hain. HCN seedhe use nahi hoti kyunke yeh intehai zehreeli gas hai; is ki bajaye sodium ya potassium cyanide aur carbonyl compound ke aabi mehlool mein dheere dheere mineral acid (HCl) mila kar mixture mein hi banayi jati hai.

items: CH3COCH3 + HCN -> (CH3)2C(OH)CN (2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile), KCN/HCl; yeh Perspex, aik shaffaf plastic, banane mein darmiyani maadda hai.

blocks.text: Mechanism: HCN na achha nucleophile hai na itna taqatwar tezaab ke zyada cyanide ions de, is liye KCN thori zyada miqdar mein use hoti hai, jis se kuch azad CN- ions bachte hain jo reaction shuru karte aur munasib raftaar se chalate hain.

items: CN- delta+ carbonyl carbon par hamla karta aur C=O ke pi electrons oxygen par chale jate hain, anion banta hai: RCHO + CN- <=> RCH(O-)CN.
Anion HCN se proton le kar hydroxynitrile banata aur CN- wapas deta hai: RCH(O-)CN + HCN <=> RCH(OH)CN + CN-.

blocks.alt: KCN (zyada) + HCl se HCN + KCl, azad CN- bachte. CN- se RCHO ke delta+ carbon tak curly teer aur C=O bond se O tak doosra, darmiyani anion banta jis ke carbon par O-, R, H aur CN; H-CN ke saath yeh hydroxynitrile RCH(OH)CN aur CN- banta.
blocks.caption: HCN ke nucleophilic addition ka mechanism (kitab ke khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Cyanide ion nucleophile aur carbonyl carbon electrophile hai. Hamle ke baad manfi charge wala oxygen HCN molecule se proton leta, jis se naya cyanide ion nikalta hai, is liye cyanide catalyst ki tarah kaam karta hai. Dono qadam ulat sakte hain, lekin equilibria bohat daen taraf hain, is liye zyada tar carbonyl compounds cyanohydrins ki achhi miqdar dete hain.

blocks.text: Nitriles halke tezaab ya aabi alkali se hydrolyse ho kar carboxylic acids ya carboxylate ions dete hain (topic 23.4.1).

Kyunke aldehydes aur ketones alcohols ki oxidation se bante hain, un ki reduction se alcohols ban sakte hain. NaBH4 ya LiAlH4 jaise reducing agent se aldehydes primary alcohols aur ketones secondary alcohols dete hain: CH3CHO + 2[H] -> CH3CH2OH (NaBH4, paani/OH-); CH3COCH3 + 2[H] -> CH3CH(OH)CH3, propan-2-ol (NaBH4, alkaline aabi mehlool). Brackets mein [H] NaBH4 se milne wale hydrogen ki nishani hai jo mua'adla balance karta hai; is ka matlab atomic hydrogen nahi.

blocks.alt: Hydride ion H- RCHO ke delta+ carbonyl carbon par hamla karta jab ke C=O ke electrons O par jate, alkoxide ion banta; alkoxide H-OH se H le kar alcohol aur OH- banata. Dabba: CH3CHO + 2[H] -> CH3CH2OH (primary) aur CH3COCH3 + 2[H] -> CH3CH(OH)CH3 (secondary).
blocks.caption: Hydride ions se carbonyl compounds ki reduction (kitab ke khaake ke mutabiq asal mechanism).
blocks.long_description: Reducing agent hydride ions, H-, ka zariya hai, jo nucleophiles hain. Hydride carbonyl carbon se jurta, aur banne wala oxygen anion phir paani se proton leta hai. C=O group CH-OH group ban jata hai.

blocks.text: Aldehydes aur ketones 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine (2,4-DNPH) ke saath condensation reaction kar ke wazeh pighalne ke darjon wale narangi qalmi thos dete hain. Reagent C=O group par jurta aur phir paani ka aik molecule nikal jata hai. Maslan ethanal ethanal 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazone ke narangi qalmein deta hai: CH3CHO + H2N-NH-C6H3(NO2)2 -> CH3CH=N-NH-C6H3(NO2)2 + H2O. Yeh reagent carbonyl compounds ki pehchan mein use hota hai. Carboxylic acids, esters, acyl halides aur amides, jin mein bhi C=O group hai, yeh test nahi dete.

blocks.alt: Ethanal + 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine (benzene ring par H2N-NH- aur positions 2 aur 4 par NO2 groups) se ethanal 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazone (usi ring par CH3CH=N-NH-) + H2O. Test tube mein narangi precipitate; notes: precipitate ka pighalne ka darja compound pehchanta hai, aur tezaab, esters, acyl chlorides aur amides react nahi karte.
blocks.caption: Aldehydes aur ketones ke liye 2,4-DNPH test (kitab ke mua'adle aur Figure 23.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Reagent ka NH2 group carbonyl carbon se jurta aur paani nikalta hai, is liye C=O, C=N ban jata hai. Narangi product aasani se saaf hota hai; is ke pighalne ke darje ko tables se mila kar asal aldehyde ya ketone pehchana ja sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: KCN ki maujoodgi mein propanone aur HCN ke reaction se kya banta hai, aur KCN kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile, (CH3)2C(OH)CN. KCN azad CN- ions, yani nucleophile, deta hai; akeli HCN bohat kam deti hai.

items: HCN (KCN + HCl se) C=O par: hydroxynitriles; CN- wapas milta.
NaBH4/LiAlH4: aldehyde -> primary, ketone -> secondary alcohol.
2,4-DNPH: sirf aldehydes aur ketones ke saath narangi precipitate.
